statement: Build a one-file website for Sweet Crumbs Bakery in Pune with a menu, a cake order form that opens a prefilled WhatsApp chat, and a contact section.
audience: Customers in Pune who want to browse the bakery's menu, order a cake, or contact the bakery.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file; CDN libraries allowed; no build step.
Readable and usable on a phone screen as well as a desktop.
No invented facts: any figure or detail not given in the brief or the CEO's decisions appears as a visibly marked placeholder.
The site takes no payment and stores no customer data.
rules: Cake prices are shown as 'starting from'; all other menu items show fixed prices.
Cake orders are placed through a form that opens WhatsApp with the details prefilled; every order is confirmed manually by the bakery.
Fulfilment is pickup or delivery within a named list of Pune areas, kept in one editable block.
Every placeholder is visibly marked on the page and listed in open_inputs.
done_when: The file is a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inside it, and needs no build step or server.
The page names Sweet Crumbs Bakery and Pune, and has three clearly labelled sections: menu, cake orders, contact.
The menu section lists items in groups; cake entries show a 'starting from' price and non-cake entries show a fixed price; any price not yet known is a visibly marked placeholder.
The cake order section has a form with fields for cake details (size, flavour, date, message), pickup or delivery choice, delivery area and delivery address.
Submitting the form opens a WhatsApp link (wa.me) whose message text is built from the form fields; the WhatsApp number is a single marked placeholder value in the script.
The page states that delivery is available within a named list of Pune areas plus pickup, and the area list is in one editable block; if areas are not yet known the block holds marked placeholders.
The page states that orders are confirmed by the bakery after the WhatsApp message is sent.
The contact section shows the bakery's address, phone, WhatsApp link and opening hours; any value not yet known is a visibly marked placeholder.
The file contains no payment processing, no server calls and no storage of customer data.
Every placeholder in the file uses one consistent visible marker, and each one corresponds to an entry in open_inputs.
The file includes a responsive layout rule (viewport meta tag and a small-screen style) so the three sections stack and stay readable on a phone.
open_inputs: Bakery WhatsApp number for order messages and the contact link.
Menu items and their categories (cakes and non-cake items).
'Starting from' prices for cakes and fixed prices for non-cake items.
Named list of Pune areas for delivery.
Bakery street address for pickup and the contact section.
Any logo, photos or brand colours the bakery wants used.
